# Wolfberry.TelldusLive

A .NET library (netstandard2.0) for the [Telldus Live API](https://api.telldus.com). Covers all 180 public API methods. Compatible with .NET Framework 4.6.1+ and .NET 5–10.

## Install

```
dotnet add package Wolfberry.TelldusLive
```

## Authentication

Credentials are obtained from https://api.telldus.com/keys/index. Four values are required:

- `consumerKey` — Public Key in the API portal
- `consumerKeySecret` — Private Key in the API portal
- `accessToken` — Token in the API portal
- `accessTokenSecret` — Token Secret in the API portal

```csharp
var client = new TelldusLiveClient(consumerKey, consumerKeySecret, accessToken, accessTokenSecret);
```

The client implements `IDisposable`. Dispose it when done, or register it as a singleton in a DI container.

## Repositories

The client exposes 7 repositories as properties:

| Property | Type | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `client.Devices` | `IDeviceRepository` | Control and query devices |
| `client.Sensors` | `ISensorRepository` | Read sensor values and history |
| `client.Clients` | `IClientRepository` | Manage controllers (e.g. Tellstick Znet Lite) |
| `client.Events` | `IEventRepository` | Manage automation events |
| `client.Scheduler` | `ISchedulerRepository` | Manage scheduled jobs |
| `client.Groups` | `IGroupRepository` | Manage device groups |
| `client.User` | `IUserRepository` | Manage user account |

All methods are async and return strongly typed response objects. All methods accept an optional `format` parameter (`"json"` default or `"xml"`).

## Devices

```csharp
// List all devices
var devices = await client.Devices.GetDevicesAsync();

// Get device details
var device = await client.Devices.GetDeviceInfoAsync(deviceId);

// Control power
await client.Devices.TurnOnAsync(deviceId);
await client.Devices.TurnOffAsync(deviceId);

// Dim to level 0–255
await client.Devices.DimAsync(deviceId, level: 128);

// Set RGB color
await client.Devices.SetRgbAsync(deviceId, red: 255, green: 0, blue: 0);

// Bell / up / down / stop (for blinds etc.)
await client.Devices.BellAsync(deviceId);
await client.Devices.UpAsync(deviceId);
await client.Devices.DownAsync(deviceId);
await client.Devices.StopAsync(deviceId);

// Get command history
var history = await client.Devices.GetHistoryAsync(deviceId);
```

## Sensors

```csharp
// List all sensors with current values
var sensors = await client.Sensors.GetSensorsAsync(
    includeIgnored: false,
    includeValues: true,
    includeScale: true,
    includeUnit: true);

// Get a specific sensor
var sensor = await client.Sensors.GetSensorInfoAsync(sensorId, includeUnit: true);

// Get sensor history (max poll: once per 10 minutes)
var history = await client.Sensors.GetHistoryAsync(
    sensorId,
    includeKey: true,
    includeUnit: true,
    includeHumanReadableDate: true);
```

## Clients (Controllers)

```csharp
// List all controllers
var clients = await client.Clients.GetClientsAsync();

// Get controller details
var info = await client.Clients.GetClientInfoAsync(clientId);
```

## Events (Automations)

```csharp
// List all events and groups
var events = await client.Events.GetEventsAsync(eventsOnly: false);

// Get full event details (triggers, conditions, actions)
var eventInfo = await client.Events.GetEventInfoAsync(eventId);
```

## Scheduler

```csharp
// List all scheduled jobs
var jobs = await client.Scheduler.GetJobsAsync();

// Get a specific job
var job = await client.Scheduler.GetJobAsync(jobId);
```

## Error Handling

All repository methods throw `RepositoryException` on API errors. Wrap calls in try/catch:

```csharp
try
{
    await client.Devices.TurnOnAsync(deviceId);
}
catch (RepositoryException ex)
{
    Console.WriteLine($"API error: {ex.Message}");
}
```

Configuration errors (missing credentials) throw `ConfigurationException` at client construction time.

## MCP Server

An MCP server wrapping this library is available in the `Wolfberry.TelldusLive.MCP` project. It exposes 17 tools covering devices, sensors, clients, events, scheduler, and user — ready to use with Claude, Cursor, and any MCP-compatible agent.

Configure via environment variables:
- `TELLDUS_CONSUMER_KEY`
- `TELLDUS_CONSUMER_KEY_SECRET`
- `TELLDUS_ACCESS_TOKEN`
- `TELLDUS_ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET`
